runner_help:
usage: autoresearch_loop.py [-h]
                            [--transforms {dedupe,opacity-strip,dedupe} [{dedupe,opacity-strip,dedupe} ...]]
                            [--max-cycles MAX_CYCLES] [--apply]
                            [--run-id RUN_ID] [--runs-root RUNS_ROOT]
                            chapter

Bounded autoresearch loop (dry-run default)

positional arguments:
  chapter               path to chapter markdown

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --transforms {dedupe,opacity-strip,dedupe} [{dedupe,opacity-strip,dedupe} ...]
                        ordered one-variable transforms
  --max-cycles MAX_CYCLES
  --apply               mutate the chapter (default: dry-run)
  --run-id RUN_ID       write artifacts under runs/<run-id>/<book>/<chapter>
  --runs-root RUNS_ROOT
                        artifact root (default: WORKBENCH/STORYOPS/runs)
